name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::shrink_to_fit
intro:
Requests the removal of unused capacity.

It is a non-binding request to reduce capacity() to size(). It depends on the implementation if the request is fulfilled.

If (and only if) reallocation takes place, all pointers, references, and iterators are invalidated.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the string.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: In libstdc++, shrink_to_fit() is not available in C++98 mode.
